en-US: Build 199 internal device test. Please focus on: (1) Canvas nodes: drag the body/title to move a node with finger or trackpad; only visible corner handles resize. (2) Video/image jobs: model and legacy modelID are mutually exclusive, image model discovery is available, and the job center can refresh/reconcile submitted jobs without turning a temporary status failure into a failed task. (3) Office: documents no longer remain on ‘Closing’; preview-to-edit can be repeated, Notes reopens known documents in edit mode, Office stays inside the current IDE tab, and File Manager expand opens the dedicated Office editor. (4) Local MLX: each turn releases model/Metal caches, a text turn sheds obsolete vision state, and decode/load failures get one clean rebuild retry per turn with lifecycle diagnostics. (5) Local shell: bounded output finalization, interactive Dash stdin, and safe quarantine for a genuinely non-cooperative native command. Existing Build 198 mind-map and Magic Keyboard fixes remain included. Validation was intentionally shortened: focused host checks, source parsing, xcodegen and one accepted-SDK cloud App build; full UI/device acceptance is assigned to the tester. Please report device, OS, model and shortest reproduction. No public beta submission is included.
zh-Hans: Build 199 内部真机测试。请重点验证：① 画布节点：手指或触控板拖节点主体／标题可移动，只有可见四角控制点调整大小。② 视频／图片任务：model 与旧 modelID 明确二选一，支持图片模型枚举，任务中心可主动刷新并恢复已提交任务，临时状态查询失败不会把任务误判失败。③ Office：不再卡在“正在关闭”；预览转编辑可重复使用；手记中已打开过的文档再次进入默认编辑；Office 留在当前 IDE 标签内；文件管理器放大直接进入专用 Office 编辑器。④ 本地 MLX：每轮释放模型与 Metal 缓存，纯文字轮释放无用视觉状态；解码／加载失败每轮最多自动清理重建一次，并留下生命周期日志。⑤ 本地 Shell：输出收尾有界、Dash 交互输入修复；真正无法协作取消的原生命令会安全隔离并报忙。Build 198 的思维导图与妙控键盘修复继续包含。本轮按要求缩短验证：只做聚焦宿主检查、源码解析、xcodegen 和一次验收 SDK 云端 App 构建，完整 UI／真机验收由测试者完成。反馈请附设备、系统、模型与最短复现步骤。本轮不提交公开 Beta。
